name: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 – Cebu
short_description: A half-marathon event in Cebu City, Philippines, taking place on October 11, 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.

research_highlights: The Cebu 2026 edition starts at City di Mare by Filinvest, Cebu City, with the first gun start at midnight (12AM), on October 11, 2026.
The event is part of a wider 2026 series held across six Philippine cities (Manila, Davao, Cebu, Iloilo, CDO, Clark), each with its own night race and neon-lit, music-driven theme.
Registration is handled online via Race Roster, with limited slots on a first-come, first-served basis and non-transferable bibs.
The previous Cebu edition (HOKA Midnight Run Asia - Cebu 2025) took place November 30, 2025, also at City di Mare by Filinvest.
Wheeled devices (skates, strollers), pets, and face-covering costumes are prohibited on the racecourse per official race mechanics.
research_watchouts: A participant commenting on the event's official Facebook page reported that results from the series' Manila leg (July 19, 2026) remained unposted nearly a month later and said the page was not responding to messages, raising questions about post-race results turnaround and organizer responsiveness.

Little independent, first-hand runner commentary (course conditions, crowd support, heat management) specific to the Cebu leg was found publicly at the time of this search; most available material is organizer/marketing copy rather than participant reviews.
